_note: worker_name is a DECLARATION, checked against wrangler.toml [env.production] name. If the two disagree the sync aborts. Every key the vault holds must appear in secret_names or in not_synced with a written reason; one in neither aborts the sync by name.

not_synced.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: The credential this sync authenticates WITH. Uploading it to the Worker would put the key that can rewrite every secret inside the thing it rewrites.
not_synced.GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: Search Console service account, used by local operator scripts on her Mac. Nothing in the Worker reads it and a Worker secret is not where a service-account JSON belongs.
not_synced.RUNWAY_API_KEY: Video generation, driven from her Mac by the slate tooling. No Worker route reaches it.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_SEQ_TAYLOR: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_WESTPEEK: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_STAYLOR_SPRY: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CAL_ICS_CRYPTOCLEARR: Calendar feed URL read by the local calendar:sync job, not by the Worker.
not_synced.CRYPTOCLEARR_IMAP_PASSWORD: IMAP password used by the local mailbox sweep. The Worker receives mail through Cloudflare Email Routing and never opens an IMAP connection.
not_synced.SOS_IMAP_PASSWORD: IMAP password used by the local mailbox sweep. Same reason.
not_synced.WP_OS_NETWORK_OS_SESSION_SECRET: Belongs to West Peek OS, a different application. Boss OS carries West Peek chassis code by copy and diverge and must never hold its credentials.
